description: Reads the open model's geometry tables and CIVIL NX's computed section properties and reports the bridge the Model to IFC plugin finds in it: girder lines, piers and pylons (station, elements, bearings, foundations), abutments, bearings, the deck alignment and its line/arc fit, the joined deck, every section in use with how its outline was rebuilt and its area difference from CIVIL NX, tendons, weightless members left out, volumes per material. Read-only; writes no file. Use it before model_to_ifc / model_to_dxf, or to sanity-check a model.

joinDeck.description: Join side-by-side girders' slab strips into one continuous deck.

name.description: File / model name (default: the model's project name).

separateSlabs.description: A composite section's deck slab as its own slab.

skipWeightless.description: Leave out weightless (dummy) members; cables, piles and members named NoSW are kept.

startStation.description: Chainage at the start of the deck, m.

tendons.description: Tendons drawn at their duct diameter.

name: model_bridge_summary
title: Model to IFC — what the exporter sees
